hub.title: Games
hub.subtitle: Free games to play with friends: in a call, in a chat, or on your own.
hub.free: Every game is free. No purchases, no betting, no ads.

tictactoe.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
tictactoe.rules: Take turns placing your mark. The first to get three in a row (across, down or diagonally) wins. A full board with no line is a draw. Who starts alternates every match.

connect4.name: Connect Four
connect4.rules: Take turns dropping a disc into one of the seven columns; it falls to the lowest free space. Four of your discs in a row (across, down or diagonally) wins. A full board is a draw.

rps.name: Rock, Paper, Scissors
rps.rules: Both players pick at the same time; neither sees the other's pick until both have chosen. Rock beats scissors, scissors beat paper, paper beats rock. A player who doesn't pick within 30 seconds loses the round. Win the majority of rounds to win the match.

chess.name: Chess
chess.rules: Standard chess rules, including castling, en passant and promotion. Checkmate wins. Stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition and the fifty-move rule are draws, and you can offer a draw or resign. With a clock, running out of time loses. Colours alternate every match.

checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.rules: American checkers (English draughts) on an 8×8 board. Men move one square diagonally forward; kings move one square in any diagonal direction. Capturing is compulsory and a capture continues while the same piece can jump again; you may choose any capturing sequence. A man reaching the far row is crowned and the move ends. A player with no legal move loses; 40 moves each without a capture or crowning is a draw.

battleship.name: Battleship
battleship.rules: Place your five ships (5, 4, 3, 3 and 2 squares) in secret; ships may touch but not overlap. Then take turns firing one shot at the other grid. Sink every enemy ship to win. Your opponent only sees a ship of yours once it's sunk.

memory.name: Memory Match
memory.rules: On your turn, flip two cards. A pair scores a point and you go again; otherwise both stay visible for a moment and the turn passes. The player with the most pairs wins.

wordrace.name: Word Race
wordrace.rules: Both players try to find the same five-letter word, six guesses each. Green: right letter in the right place. Yellow: in the word, wrong place. You only see how many guesses your opponent has made. The first to solve it wins; if nobody does, it's a draw.

hangman.name: Hangman
hangman.blurb: Guess the word letter by letter.
hangman.rules: One player picks a word (or a random one); the other guesses letters, or the whole word. Six wrong guesses and the word-setter wins. Roles swap every match.

wordduel.name: Word Duel
wordduel.rules: The first word starts with a random letter; every word after that must start with the last letter of the previous word. Words need at least three letters and can't repeat. Each word scores one point per letter, +1 for each K, V, W or Y and +3 for each J, Q, X or Z. Each player has 8 turns of 30 seconds; the higher total wins.

trivia.name: Trivia Battle
trivia.rules: Everyone answers the same question within 20 seconds. A right answer scores 500 points plus up to 500 more for answering quickly. After the last question, the highest score wins.

drawing.name: Sketch & Guess
drawing.rules: Each round, everyone takes a turn drawing. The drawer picks one of three words and draws it; the others type guesses. Guessing right scores 100 points plus up to 200 for speed, and the drawer gets 50 for each correct guess. Letters are revealed as time runs down. The highest score at the end wins.
